name: Songs of the Storm ahead
source:
Delirious and confused, you wake up on a beach with no memory of who you are and how you got there. Only you get approached by two women, both of which seem to know you.

[From [url=https://soysaucedisorder.itch.io/songs-of-the-storm-ahead-demo]itch.io[/url]]
